meta.title: The Tasting Menu
meta.author: Engine Showcase
meta.description: An expanded showcase story. A first date, a grueling seven-course meal, spicy ceviche, tableside theatrics, and a waiter who simply refuses to let your water glass fall below the brim.

characters.name: Alex
characters.notes: Really likes this date. Really regrets the pre-date nervous pint.

characters.name: Jordan
characters.notes: The date. Gorgeous, highly observant, and easily distracted by culinary theatrics.

characters.name: The Waiter
characters.notes: A culinary ninja. His life's mission is topping up water glasses and enforcing restaurant pacing.

leakOnFail.bladder: That was a spasm. A little got out. Cross your legs and act natural.

triggers.bladder: Warning. We have bypassed 'uncomfortable' and are rapidly approaching 'critical.'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The restaurant is dim, romantic, and extremely expensive. The pre-date pint you had to calm your nerves is already making its presence known.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I'm so glad we finally did this! I've been dying to try their seven-course menu.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Sparkling water for the table? Excellent.

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: He poured it. It's sitting right there, bubbling at you.

choices.text: Toast to a great evening. Take a healthy sip of wine.
Toast, but fake-sip. Let the liquid hit your lip and go no further.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Course two arrives. It is a delicate scallop ceviche bathed in a bright orange chili oil.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Oh wow! That has a serious kick to it. I love spicy food, do you?

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: Do not eat that. If you eat that, you will burn. If you burn, you will drink. If you drink, we sink.

choices.text: Eat it boldly to match their energy. Reach for the ice water.
Take a tiny bite and suffer the burn in total, stoic silence.

minigame.prompt: Do not sweat. Do not cough.

choices.text: Pretend to eat it, strategically moving the scallops around the plate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ceviche plates are cleared. A golden opportunity. You place your hands on your armrests to stand up.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: For our intermezzo, a smoked rosemary infusion. Please, remain seated for your safety while I pour the liquid nitrogen.

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: He is doing this on purpose. I know it.

choices.text: Sit back down obediently. Do not disrupt the liquid nitrogen.
"Excuse me just a moment!" Make a break for it before he starts pouring.

scenes.title: 8:05 PM — Course Four: The Endless Story

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Course four. The nitrogen fog has cleared. Jordan is deep into a fascinating, uninterrupted story about their childhood golden retriever.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: ...and so Barnaby just sat there, covered in paint! Anyway, sorry, I'm rambling. Are you okay? You look a bit rigid.

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: Do not stand up. If you stand up right now, it's game over.

choices.text: "I'm just captivated! Tell me more about Barnaby."

minigame.prompt: Count the candles. In order. Look fascinated.

choices.text: "I'm great. Let me just use the restroom real quick before the next course."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The dog story ends. Course five is cleared. Suddenly, Jordan's phone vibrates. They look at the screen, wincing.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: It's my sister, it's an emergency. I have to step outside for just a second. I am so sorry!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jordan rushes outside. You are alone. The restroom is fifty feet away.

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: THEY LEFT. WE ARE ALONE. STAND UP AND WALK.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Sir, while your guest is away, the Chef insists you try this complimentary liquid sphere tasting. It must be consumed immediately.

choices.text: Nod politely, eat the liquid sphere, and wait for Jordan to return.
Use the alone time to secretly squirm in your chair and relieve the pressure.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jordan returns, apologizing profusely. You survived the gap. But while you were distracted greeting them, a shadow falls over the table.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Allow me to top that up for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The waiter pours ice-cold water into your glass. The sound of trickling water fills your ears. It is deafening.

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: MAKE IT STOP.

choices.text: Stare at the tablecloth and try to block out the sound.

minigame.prompt: Block out the pouring. Keep me level.

choices.text: Clang your fork against your plate to drown out the noise.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Hey... are you sure you're okay? You keep shifting around and you've barely touched your wine.

choices.text: "Just a bit of a back spasm! I'm totally fine."
"Actually, I think the ceviche is disagreeing with me..."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dessert is finished. The date went beautifully. The waiter brings the card machine.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.text: Apologies, the terminal is just running a software update. It should only be another five minutes.

lines.speaker: bladder
lines.text: Five minutes. We don't have five seconds. Throw cash at him and run.

choices.text: Smile through the pain. Maintain eye contact. Do not vibrate.

minigame.prompt: I'm cracking! Patch me! HOLD IT TOGETHER!

choices.text: Throw a hundred dollar bill on the table and stand up abruptly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You stop mid-sentence. Jordan is still talking, but the words have turned into a pleasant noise somewhere far away.
lines.bladder: I'm done. I'm sorry. I gave you every course I had.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: No. Not at the table. Just until the bill. Please.
lines.bladder: There is no 'until' left. I checked. Twice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your knuckles are white on the tablecloth. The one evening you wanted to go perfectly, and your own body has filed its resignation.
lines.bladder: It was a lovely date. You were charming. I was heroic. It simply ran long.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ...Okay. Okay.
lines.bladder: Letting go now. Reach for the water glass. It will explain a lot.

endings.title: A Flawless Evening
endings.text: The machine beeps. Payment approved. You walk Jordan to a cab at a perfectly measured pace, secure a second date, and then sprint into the nearest dark alleyway the moment their car turns the corner. A complete success.

endings.title: The Bathroom Break
endings.text: You successfully bolted to the restroom mid-meal. When you return, the Waiter is glaring at you, and the delicate timing of the tasting menu is ruined. Jordan is polite about it, but you definitely lost points for abandoning the liquid nitrogen.

endings.title: The Eccentric Exit
endings.text: You drop the cash, mumble something about 'hating to wait,' and speed-walk to the restrooms. Jordan thinks you're weirdly impatient and a terrible tipper, but at least you kept your dignity. Mostly.

endings.title: The Mood Killer
endings.text: You interrupted Barnaby the dog's climax to run to the toilet. When you return, the magic is gone. Jordan is scrolling on their phone. You survived, but there won't be a second date.

endings.title: The Sickly Date
endings.text: You blamed the ceviche. Now Jordan feels terrible for picking the restaurant, the waiter is offended, and you spend the rest of the night pretending to have food poisoning. It's safe to say romance is dead.

endings.title: The Jig Is Up
endings.text: Jordan stops mid-sentence. 'Are you doing a pee dance? Oh my god, just go to the bathroom!' You are officially a 28-year-old who needs permission to pee. Mortifying.

endings.title: Check Please
endings.text: The five-minute terminal update was the final straw. Control fails right there at the table. You knock over the water glass trying to stand up, but the water on the chair definitely isn't from the glass. Check, please.
